title: Pudgy Penguins accused of infringing Original Penguin trademark
summary: The company behind the clothing brand Original Penguin has accused Pudgy Penguins’ clothing merchandise of infringing on its trademarks.

title: Altcoin seasons are over, expect ‘non-traditional’ cycles ahead: Bitwise exec
summary: The altcoins with “real world” traction and application will be the winners of the next altcoin season, says Bitwise’s Matt Hougan.

title: Bitcoin relief rally faces headwinds as bear market persists: analysts
summary: “Even after the recent price rally, fundamental and technical indicators still point to a bear market environment,” said CryptoQuant.

title: Lyn Alden tips Bitcoin outperforming gold over next ‘two to three years’
summary: Macroeconomist Lyn Alden says gold has a “somewhat euphoric” sentiment around it, while Bitcoin is being treated “somewhat unfairly negative.”

title: Solana ETFs still hold ‘impressive numbers’ even as token dives 57%
summary: Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas says Solana ETF inflows are posting “pretty impressive numbers,” even as the token has dropped by more than half since they launched.

title: Solv Protocol offers 10% bounty after $2.7M vault exploit
summary: Crypto security researchers say the hacker exploited a bug allowing them to mint tokens, before swapping the freely-gained tokens for another tied to Bitcoin.

title: US regulators say tokenized securities subject to same capital rules
summary: The Federal Reserve and US banking regulators have clarified that tokenized securities are subject to the same capital treatment as traditional assets.

title: Dems plan bill to curb prediction markets after ‘very specific’ Iran strike bets
summary: Senator Chris Murphy says it’s likely people close to Donald Trump with “inside information” made bets on prediction markets on when the US would strike Iran.

title: Construction begins at quantum facility big enough to break Bitcoin
summary: PsiQuantum co-founder Terry Rudolph said in July it has no plans to attack Bitcoin, even if its upcoming facility becomes powerful enough to break the blockchain’s cryptography.

title: SEC ends case against Justin Sun with $10M settlement
summary: The US SEC ended its lawsuit against crypto entrepreneur Justin Sun after one of his companies agreed to pay a $10 million settlement, closing a three-year legal battle.
